layouts: Flat and 100-files-per-folder nested layouts; deep40 distributes files evenly along a 40-directory single-child chain, with special entries and empty directory at its deepest leaf
memory_method: Separate fresh Python-process peak RSS/physical footprint from time -lp. Includes interpreter, import and child count/hash checks; excludes parent runner. Same startup for every method. Wrapper times are diagnostics, not API timing results or standalone C-engine memory.
native_origin: Installed runtime outside source checkout; memory children verify the same binary hash
timing: Python API wall and process CPU time; native implementations; warm OS cache; no process startup

comparison_method.baseline: POSIX readdir/fstatat in the same installed extension, not a separate Apple command.
comparison_method.timing: 11 API samples after two warmups; all 117 rows retained. Wall and process CPU exclude interpreter startup.
comparison_method.memory: Three fresh Python processes per method/layout; all 27 rows retained. Peak RSS/footprint include interpreter, imports and validation, not standalone engine memory.
comparison_method.formulas: Difference is candidate minus POSIX; ratio is POSIX/candidate. Negative differences and ratios above one favor candidate.
comparison_method.ranges: Three-sample observed ranges are not confidence intervals; overlapping ranges do not establish a memory advantage.
comparison_method.cpu_utilization: Median of each measured process CPU/wall ratio; average occupied cores, not peak or machine-wide load.
comparison_method.scope: Synthetic layouts do not establish universal filesystem gains.

export_provenance.preservation: Every original field and row, including warmups, losses and diagnostics, is unchanged.
